prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: The students are familiar with the basic concepts of the dynamics of solid and fluid bodies in a unified representation.
The students have the competence to apply the principles of kinematics and dynamics to fundamental model problems and to develop appropriate (computer-friendly) formulations and computational models.

syllabus_topics: Impulse and angular momentum theorems for material volumes and for mass flow through control volumes
Demonstration of calculation and practice of independent solving of fundamental dynamics problems
